patterns.comment: Show-now line: any line whose first non-tab char is `!` reveals its pane/session now. Matched first so the whole line reads as one scope the theme flags black-on-white, overriding the per-item coloring below — the only form of `!` duckies recognises. A `!` anywhere else in a line is ordinary text.
patterns.name: markup.other.shownow.duckies

patterns.comment: Sleep scope: a header or worktree label whose first non-tab char is `?` is slept (duckies tears its tmux down but keeps the conversation). Greys the WHOLE scope — the `?` line and every line indented deeper than it — so the dormant block reads as inactive. `\1` captures the `?` line's indent; the region ends at the first line not indented past it (the next sibling/header), mirroring parse()'s cascade. Matched before the item/label rules; no sigil item starts with `?`.
patterns.name: markup.other.sleep.duckies

patterns.comment: Comment: any row starting with `#` (at any indent, incl. column 0) is ignored.
Macro call: a `@name [args]` line the controller expands to a reusable block. A name char must follow the `@`, so a `@@@…` body line never matches.

Template call: a `>name [args]` line the controller PASTES — it physically replaces this line in the file with the named body, so the injected rows become ordinary visible items. A name char must follow the `>` (so a `->` note never matches); matched before the session-header/worktree fallback so `>name` isn't read as a label.

DUCKIES directive: a `DUCKIES: <text>` line (any indent, incl. column 0) runs a background agent to edit the .dk files themselves. Case-sensitive so ordinary prose never trips it; matched before the session-header/worktree fallback so it isn't read as a label.

Widget call: a `&name [args]` line — a status display, mirroring its output below as `| ` lines. The `&name` line and the `| ` output lines directly under it form one block (painted white-on-dark-grey); the block ends at the first line that is not a `| ` continuation, so a prompt body `|` stays untouched.
Prompt: `prompt:` or the `:` shorthand; `::`/`:2` select the lane/pane.
Multiline prompt body: a `|` line continues the prompt above it (YAML block-scalar style), so a pasted body is never mistaken for a worktree.
Command: `$`/`$$`/`$2` runs in the shell window; the rest is the command.
Show item: a bare `show` (any case) or a bare `!` brings the session on screen.

Clear item: a bare `%`/`%%`/`%N` collapses its lane's completed run below it. Matched before the worktree fallback so `%` isn't read as a label; the theme gives it a yellow background so it stands out as an action mark.
Status marker: [EXECUTING] (active). A leading `!` (reveal now) is handled by the show-now rule above.
Status marker: [DONE] (success).
Status marker: [NEEDS ATTENTION] (alarm).
Status marker: [ERROR] (a failed $command; halts the lane).
Status marker: [WAITING] (turn ended, but backgrounded tasks will resume claude on their own).
Any other bracketed marker (e.g. [NO DIR …], [DUPLICATE]) is a session marker.

Note: a `-> …` line duckies mirrors below a finished prompt (an inert one-line summary of the turn). Matched before the worktree fallback so the non-sigil line isn't read as a worktree label. Scoped as a comment so it inherits the theme's comment styling, matching the `#` rows above.
patterns.name: comment.line.note.duckies

patterns.comment: Worktree label: a tab-indented, non-sigil line (a git worktree of the enclosing repo). Mirrors parse()'s fallback branch; styled as a class name, the same scope as the repo header it stands in for. A leading `!` (show it now) is handled by the show-now rule above.
Session header: a column-0 line. A leading `!` (switch to it now) is handled by the show-now rule above.
